questions: Which sites work?

Sites with configured chapter selectors support automatic novel detection. The text picker and AI tools can also work on ordinary web pages; browser-internal pages are excluded. You can ask your selected Cloud or Desktop AI to help detect a page layout.
Do I need an account?

You can start with a guest account. Register on this website to contribute where your permissions allow, use Story Lens Cloud and manage your lenses. The extension in this browser can connect to the same account.
Does it work offline?

Downloaded novel reference data remains available offline. Supported local edits queue for synchronization; new server requests and AI features need a connection. Downloading reference data does not download the novel’s chapters.
Which AI does it use?

Choose Story Lens Cloud with lenses, or the free desktop companion with your own Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI account. Text and image sources can be chosen separately. Desktop image generation uses Codex; provider plans and usage limits still apply.
How do chapter covers work?

Generate a cover from the current chapter, novel context and mentioned characters’ descriptions and images. The saved cover is shared with readers of that chapter and appears before its text. Automatic generation is off by default; enabling it can spend lenses when Cloud is your image source.
Do my colors change the shared glossary?

Personal category and nature colors change how you see the story and sync with your account. They do not replace the shared colors for other readers. You can clear an override to return to the shared color.
Is Arabic supported?

Yes. The extension and website support English and Arabic with right-to-left layout. Glossary entries can hold names and descriptions in both languages, and Arabic matching ignores vowel marks with optional alif-variant matching.
What about Firefox?
The source includes Firefox builds. A published Firefox listing has not been verified, so we currently link to Chrome and the source repository.
Is it open source?
The source is available under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. Commercial use requires separate permission.
Is it free to use?

The extension’s reading tools are free. Story Lens Cloud AI actions use lenses, with current prices on the Pricing page. The desktop companion uses no lenses; your own AI provider’s plan and limits apply.

pricing.description: AI summaries, character details and images, and shared chapter covers. Use Story Lens Cloud with lenses or the free desktop companion with your own AI account.
pricing.headline: Pay only for the AI you use
pricing.intro: Summaries, character details, chapter extraction, selector detection, novel research and images—including shared chapter covers—can run on Story Lens Cloud with lenses. Browsing, highlighting and your glossary stay free.

faq: An AI action takes its lenses when it starts. If it fails (an error, a timeout, an empty answer, or you cancel it), they’re refunded automatically, and a retry inside the same action is free. Lenses never expire.
Send a request from your Balance page with your WhatsApp or Telegram. We contact you to arrange payment, and your lenses are added once it’s confirmed.

Yes. The free desktop companion uses your own Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI account without lenses; your provider’s plan and limits apply. Desktop character images and chapter covers use Codex, independently of your text provider.
What is sent to AI providers?

Only what an action needs: relevant page or chapter text, names, descriptions, your prompts and, for covers, character image references. Raw prompts and answers are not stored in Cloud usage records. Saved glossary data, novel context and shared covers are stored separately. Provider retention follows their own terms; see the privacy policy.
Do automatic chapter covers use lenses?

Yes, when Cloud is your image source. Automatic cover generation is off by default. Existing shared covers are reused, and viewing them does not start a new generation. Check the current cover price before enabling automatic generation.
